article.title: Plateau senator, rep dump PDP and LP for ADC
article.text: Senator Halima Dogo-Fictional (Plateau Demo District 1) and Hon. Bitrus Dalyop-Gyang (Plateau Demo Constituency 1) on Tuesday joined the African Democratic Congress at a joint rally in Jos. Dogo-Fictional left the Labour Party while Dalyop-Gyang resigned from the Peoples Democratic Party. Both collected ADC membership cards.
